system.effect:
Prerequisites: @UUID[Compendium.ptu.references.Item.ohZHtxDDQlW0adoc]
Daily – Extended Action
Target: One Pokémon
Effect: You touch the target, and create a liquid metal skin over their body, infusing it with power. The target replaces one of its Types with the Steel type. If the target is already part Steel-Type, it instead becomes pure Steel-Type. If the target is already pure Steel-Type, it instead gains a +2 bonus to Accuracy and Critical Hit range. Regardless of other effects, the target may also use the Move Metal Burst as if it was on their Move List; if it does so, the effects of this Feature end immediately. If not ended early, this Feature’s effects last until the next Extended Rest.
